# skygo-ssh's client path against a real agent serving an
# operator-initialized installation; see TestAgentInstallationScript.

# Commands working on local files, and flags that would replace the
# agent's endpoint or credential, are refused before reaching the agent.
! skygo-ssh admin state artifacts init
stderr 'works on local files; run it on the remote host'
! skygo-ssh admin --token-file $WORK/source/seed.txt targets list
stderr 'token-file is set by skygo-ssh'
jobs 0

# The admin uploads a small workdir and runs a workspace job whose setup
# makes a file the command reads with the uploaded seed.
skygo-ssh admin artifacts upload $WORK/source
cp stdout input.json
stderr '^upload-id: '
task input.json task.json
skygo-ssh admin run -f $WORK/task.json --request-id ssh-script --wait
stdout '\tdgx\tsucceeded'
cp stdout run.txt
jobs 1

# Its result downloads with exact bytes.
job-result run.txt result.json
skygo-ssh admin artifacts download --ref $WORK/result.json $WORK/result
cmp result/out/result.txt expected.txt

# A reader can neither upload nor run, and creates no job.
! skygo-ssh carol artifacts upload $WORK/source
stderr '(?i)permission.denied'
! skygo-ssh carol run -f $WORK/task.json --request-id ssh-reader
stderr '(?i)permission.denied'
jobs 1

# Replaying the request returns the same job and runs nothing again.
skygo-ssh admin run -f $WORK/task.json --request-id ssh-script --wait
cmp stdout run.txt
jobs 1

-- source/seed.txt --
seed
-- expected.txt --
seed
prepared
